verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is API-driven. Verification sessions can be created by curl with a secret key, results can be read programmatically, and webhooks let an integration react to outcomes automatically. An isolated sandbox and an official Stripe CLI also exist. However, the documented test-mode flow has you submit sessions by selecting a predefined test case in the verification UI, so headless end-to-end runs in CI are not shown. Missing for 10: documented headless or CI completion of verification sessions without the UI, CI-specific guidance, and hands-on corroboration of automated pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can access most verification details programmatically... using your secret key.
Listen for verification results so your integration can automatically trigger reactions.
A sandbox is an isolated test environment.
